answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making every identity post a refundable bond that unlocks only after its attestations survive random peer audits. Each fake account must lock fresh capital and burn real compute on unique work, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds while one honest agent pays once. Like a walnut, the valuable kernel hides behind a hard shell: cheap for the grower to open, expensive to crack in bulk, and slashed duplicates stay marked umber on the ledger.
